title.narrative: UNIDO Global Mercury Project-2 (GMP-2), Introduction of cleaner artisanal gold mining and extraction technologies

description.narrative: The overall objective of this Project is to reduce the use of mercury and to increase both the productivity and sustainability of the San Juan mining district in Chocó. This will be achieved through the development of national politics aimed at controlling both the use and distribution of mercury. Also, promoting the appropriate use of mercury and supporting mining formalization programs.
